notes.fix: registries.ts now re-exports the shipped registries, BLOCKS_V2 = BLOCKS and ITEMS_V2 = ITEMS from @voxelcraft/gameplay, and keeps only the app helpers: 27 insertions, 237 deletions. main.ts breakAt treats a negative hardness as the contract unbreakable case, bedrock and the Nether portal at hardness -1, and only pockets definition.itemId when it is greater than 0. The portal can no longer be broken and can never insert item id 65, and mature wheat, carrot and potato carry itemId 0 so they cannot be pocketed and replanted. The client atlas and render mapping are untouched and both gate 5 and gate 7 stay green.
notes.recipes: RECIPES_V2 is deliberately not re-exported: craftFromInventory and craftableFromInventory take only the inventory and default to the shipped RECIPES internally, so an app level alias would be dead code.
